concepts.name: A 大颚矮兵
concepts.design: 普通近战；楔形大下颚、短躯干、宽前臂
concepts.prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL production-minded 2D fantasy mobile tower-defense enemy concept, a single full-body creature on a perfectly uniform warm-white background. The attached images are references for the PRINCIPLE of purposeful game-monster design: a distinctive body plan, one dominant identifying feature, clear combat role and readable big shapes. Do NOT copy any referenced character, costume, face, anatomy arrangement or palette wholesale. The three concepts in this series share the SAME rendering language: confident dark ink contour, broad flat color masses, restrained two-step cel shadows, sparing angular highlights, hand-drawn shape decisions. No airbrushed glossy rendering. Make the DESIGN specific, not a generic fantasy character made elaborate with detail. It must read as an ordinary enemy sprite at 80 pixels tall, not a collectible hero illustration. Exaggerated functional anatomy, memorable asymmetry, large connected shapes and minimal secondary detail. Cap palette at four main material colors. Adult creature with an unfriendly mischievous temperament, neither adorable baby mascot nor horror creature. Not realistic human anatomy wearing monster skin. No intricate texture, decorative runes, magic particles, floating fragments, rim lights, chest gems, multiple armor layers, or unnecessary ornaments. Show a neutral combat-ready idle, fully frontal and looking at viewer, both feet on the same baseline; no perspective foreshortening, no side-facing pose. Center the entire figure with at least 15 percent empty margin on every side for subsequent animation. No scenery, props apart from the specified weapon, panels, titles, labels, typography, gradients, circles, shadows on the backdrop or watermarks.
DESIGN A — JAW GRUNT, a low-ranking frontier raider. Build its whole silhouette around a disproportionately WIDE wedge-shaped LOWER JAW, not around a human head: the jaw projects sideways beyond its small cranium, cheeks form two blocky downward wedges, mouth is a single short lopsided dark slit with exactly TWO stubby uneven lower teeth. Tiny oblique amber eyes sit under a single heavy flat brow; a small flattened nose; two SHORT sharply triangular ears of unequal length. No wrinkled old-man face, no long hooked nose, no huge cute eyes, no smiling mascot expression. Muddy olive-green skin, dark earthy underside, one ochre cloth strip as a wide simple waist wrap. Total proportions about 2.8 heads tall: broad low head sitting directly between shoulders, extremely short compressed torso, thick elbow-led forearms reaching the thighs, short bowed legs and wide three-toed feet. The head-jaw is the dominant shape, forearms the secondary shape. Avoid heroic muscular anatomy and inflated round cheeks. One hand hangs in a simple blunt fist; the other holds ONE small broad rectangular chipped iron cleaver on a short straight wooden handle, point down and clear of body. This is a disposable close-range pack attacker, not a warrior king. Just the waist wrap and one rough wrist binding; no vest, pants, belt buckle, armor, boots, jewelry, sacks, skulls, shoulder spikes. A clear purposeful game monster with restrained geometric anatomy and distinctive silhouette, not the standard skinny goblin.

concepts.name: B 木桩投石怪
concepts.design: 普通远程；木桩即身体、树洞即脸、投索与石弹

DESIGN B — STUMP SLINGER, a small nonhuman ranged enemy of the frontier woodland. Its body IS ONE SHORT HOLLOW TREE STUMP, not a humanoid covered in bark armor, not a giant tree guardian. A slightly leaning trapezoidal trunk is the primary mass, broader at the rough cut top and narrower at the bottom. Its face consists of two small dark knothole eyes under ONE pronounced slanted wooden shelf and an off-center short horizontal split mouth; no human nose, teeth, skull mask or glowing eyes. A single crooked cut branch on the upper-left side is a recognizable silhouette accent. Two short crooked root legs end in three broad root toes; two twig-jointed arms emerge low from opposite sides. One arm is thin and bent, holding a simple coarse leather SLING downward outside the body, with ONE clearly visible round grey stone sitting in the sling cup. The other arm is a thicker broken-root shape, bent across its lower belly, holding ONE round grey stone ready to reload. A single open natural cavity on the lower side visibly stores two large round stones; this is functional ammunition storage, not a magical core. Neutral ready pose, sling is still and not being spun. The character reads as a crafty ordinary projectile grunt, not a wizard. Maximum THREE large bark planes across the front, no busy wood-grain engraving or masses of branches. Warm muted brown wood, charcoal interior, pale grey stone, a very small faded russet binding around the sling hand ties it to the frontier raider faction. No leaf crown, flowers, mushrooms, cute sprouts, glowing green energy, humanoid chest, muscular abs, bark shoulder armor, staff, crystal or face like a human old man. Focus on the unified trunk-body shape and a clearly legible ranged weapon.

concepts.name: C 短躯巨臂怪
concepts.design: 重型近战；低位小头、短身体、下垂巨臂

DESIGN C — HEAVY-ARM BRUTE, an original stocky frontline battering creature. Design its silhouette as an inverted U: two enormous low-hanging forearms framing a VERY SHORT small central body and very short feet. The arms themselves are the weapons and account for over half the visual mass; squared shovel-shaped fists hang BELOW knee level, each with THREE large flattened fingers, no weapons or props. The fists should be big SOLID shapes, not rock chunks assembled into armor. A tiny blunt rectangular head is recessed between the high shoulders, with no visible neck, no visible external ears, no horns, tusks or hair. A single broad flat pale brow overhangs TWO tiny horizontal amber eye slits. A small downturned mouth cut near the bottom, no exaggerated fangs or roar. The head should look stubborn and dim, threatening through weight rather than horror. Short thick thighs, wide planted feet, hunchback; squat forward pressure but fully frontal. Skin is solid desaturated warm slate grey, the broad forearm front surfaces are darker slate, and each fist has ONE blunt pale sand-colored natural knuckle ridge. NOT a lava golem, not a furry yeti, not a tree creature, no crystals, no glowing cracks, no carved skull face or energy center. One simple small torn russet waist wrap is the ONLY clothing and a faction cue. No bodybuilder pectoral anatomy, six-pack, heroic pose, layered armor, wrist bracers, jewelry or belts. About 2.5 head-equivalent body units tall, visually taller and heavier than a little grunt but still a regular battlefield monster. Large connected planes, minimal surface markings, deliberately disproportionate heavy anatomy. Its memorable quality is the little low face almost lost between two low-hanging crushing arms.
